edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest a small average effect that is directionally consistent but not dramatic.
edges.mechanism: This factor changes substrate delivery, microbial competition, short-chain fatty-acid production, or early-life colonization patterns in the gut. Those changes are most directly linked to Colonic butyrate production when the endpoint is microbial composition, barrier function, or a gut-mediated immune phenotype.
edges.summary: Inulin appears tied to better colonic butyrate production in general adult mainly through pooled meta-analytic evidence. The strongest gut-related effects usually appear in intermediate outcomes such as fermentation products, stool features, or symptom scores rather than sweeping microbiome reset claims.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
